title: 4 Belfry Gardens, Citywest, Co. Dublin
description:
RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS take great pleasure in presenting this absolutely fantastic three-bedroom / two-bathroom duplex apartment that has been heavily extended to the market ideally overlooking a large green area within the prestigious Belfry Gardens development, Citywest. The phrase "location, location, location" immediately springs to mind as this magnificent development is ideally positioned less than five minutes’ walk from the Luas and also within a mere stone's throw you will find the Citywest Shopping Centre, choice of bus routes giving easy access to the City Centre and a host of major road networks.

Bright, airy and most stylish internal living accommodation of c. 121 sqm comprises of entrance hallway with guest bathroom that is fully tiled, modern fully fitted kitchen, large living room with feature wall and extended family room to the rear. On the first floor you have three double bedrooms with built in wardrobes and main family bathroom which comes fully tiled. To the rear of the property you have a private & enclosed garden of the lowest maintenance with a block built shed that is great for additional storage and a highly sought after south west facing orientation making it the perfect sun trap on them long sunny summer evenings whilst the front provides ample parking overlooking a large green area.

No. 4 Belfry Gardens comes to the market in turnkey condition throughout having been lovingly maintained by its current owners with no expense spared when upgrading in recent years, it has been freshly renovated over the years with fresh painting, new flooring and top-quality fixtures & fittings. These duplex apartments are exceptionally spacious and offer a lengthy list of striking features such as extension to the rear, double-glazed windows, gas fired central heating, ample parking and sunny south facing rear to name but a few. Mixed interest is sure to be seen from a wide range of buyers such as first-time buyers looking to get on the property ladder, investors looking to capitalise on the strong rents in the area and people looking to downsize.

Register your interest today with Ray Cooke Auctioneers.
